definition.instructions: Compare the service context with the industry definitions. Select the category describing the claimed provider or service, even when the sender is suspicious. Payment methods do not establish industry. Use other for a sector outside the list and unclear for an unidentified sector.

criteria.technology_telecom: Software, devices, online accounts, internet or phones.
criteria.healthcare: Medical care, pharmacy or health insurance.
criteria.employment: Jobs, recruiting, payroll or workplace services.
criteria.unclear: Insufficient evidence to identify a sector.
